string.text: Drag a glowstick from your pack onto an artefact belt slot to wear it as a light. Detector-slot hold, throw, and existing keybinds are unchanged. Taking it off the belt converts it back.
Scales each color's native range while worn on the belt (1.0 = same as held, up to 2x). Does not change hand-held or thrown lights.
Scales the RGB color intensity of the belt light (1.0 = native color strength).
Scales the light's alpha/output strength (1.0 = native). Lower values dim the glow without changing its tint as much.
